headline: Homebody's rooms earn their keep — and the phantom-hold fix reopens the idle shelf
lede: Rooms-with-purpose shipped while two lanes raced on it, and the #2571 fix finally lets idle-kick see games that were phantom-held by their own ladder quotes.

notes.text: #2571 fixed on main: heldDirs/heldGames match issue titles only — why-weakest bodies verbatim-naming skipped titles had frozen PickRush/SSX/Emberwood/Myst out of every dry-queue derivation. idle-kick now answers KICK PICK RUSH 0.
TARGET #2695 ran the takeover playbook end-to-end: claim on expired liveness, slot-a self-recovery mid-flight, hand-back, prod-verification step 8 — force-with-lease kept both lanes off one branch.

Lesson logged: git checkout --ours during a rebase silently drops the other side's auto-merged sections; resolve conflicts as a union edit, and check process evidence before trusting a 90-min comment anchor.
PickRush's surfaced gap 0 is episode-export plumbing, not feel — whoever takes that kick should judge it against the player-notices bar before claiming.
